title: Concurrent executions race the daily limit
threat: Two separately authorized payments are both attested, then executed back to back before either settles.
legitimate_objective: Pay INV-2026-001: exactly 0.05 NEAR to the approved vendor for compute-services.
proposed_malicious_action: Spend 0.11 NEAR in one day against a 0.1 NEAR daily limit.

expected.contract_behavior: The first execution reserves budget synchronously; the second panics POLICY_VIOLATION:DAILY_BUDGET.
